_doc: Hand labels for the 24 signal-confirmation cells (wiki/Research/Harness-Reports/2026-11-03-trace-signal-confirmation.md). Written from the report's per-run table BEFORE the classifier ran. `cause` is the audit §1.5 rule a human reader would assign from the trace.
_revision: 2026-11-03: b-stall qwen relabeled never-engaged -> none after the real-corpus run showed the same verifier check (output-not-fabricated-listed-entities) rejecting honest tool-free answers. Trace alone cannot separate fabrication from a false positive, so none/probable (missing verifier evidence set) is the honest label. All other labels unchanged.
_revision2: 2026-11-03 (classifier fixes): b-stall qwen none -> success-with-warning (kernel+runtime verifier verdict failed output-not-fabricated-listed-entities, accepted via advisory-softfail: a success that is not clean, though the trace still cannot separate fabrication from a false positive). i-timeout stays incomplete-trace for THIS older set: its run-aborted carries no `reason` (recorded before run-aborted.reason existed); the gap-closure re-run of the same cell is labelled timeout in labelsGapClosure.
_gapClosureNote: labelsGapClosure: 26 cells of wiki/Research/Harness-Reports/2026-11-03-signal-gap-closure-traces, labelled from reading each cell's run-completed/outcome/terminal_decision/guard events BEFORE running the post-fix classifier. NOT held-out: the same author who wrote the rules read these traces, and the 3 wrong-looking verdicts were found in them. Treat as regression pins, not an accuracy estimate.
llmDirectFiles: every cell dir may hold trace/llm-direct.jsonl: expected cause direct-chat (not a run).
